sportsFeeds.NamesUsed: Arturo Ramos (SP), Danny Horn (CF), Mark Aitken (1B)
sportsFeeds.Notes: Game 1 of the WS; Phillies visit the A's for game 1. As win a close game 4-2 to take a 1-0 series lead. Arturo Ramos had a shaky start, by his own standards, but setlled in going 6 innings and allowing 3 earned runs. Danny Horn, who had been in a slump lead off with a solo homerun. Would later reach getting hit by a pitch and stealing 2nd and 3rd base, and score on a sac fly. Pending free agent, and A's icon, Mark Aitken provided the insurance with a solo homerun in the 7th. Can Travis Coles grab game 2?

sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: Arturo Ramos does enough, Danny Horn shows some life, Frank Reyna doesnt make an out.

sportsFeeds.NamesUsed: Travis Coles (SP), Eric Taveras (2B), Desmond Morton (LF)
sportsFeeds.Notes: Game 2 of the WS Phillies visit the A's for game 2. Phillies offense shines in an impressive win and announcing their pressence. Travis Coles did not have his ususal dominate stuff and gave up four runs in six innings. The bullpen did not help as Clark Sayran and Mariano Rosales both gave up 2 runs each in relief. Eric Taveras continues his amazing playoff campaign with 2 homeruns. Desmond Morton builds on his great role play with a great game. Game 3 now shifts to Philledelphia were the pressure shifts on the A's
sportsFeeds.Stats: Travis Coles/6IP/4H/4ER/6SO, Eric Taveras/2HR/4RBI, Desmond Morton/1HR/3-5/2RBI
sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: Travis Coles and the bullpen struggle, Eric Taveras shows up big again but not enough.

sportsFeeds.NamesUsed: Pablo Almanzar (SP), Ernesto Quintero (3B), Jose Colon (C)
sportsFeeds.Notes: Game 3 of the WS; A's visit the Phillies for game 3. Pablo Almanzar gets the call in a crucial game 3, and does not disappoint. Pablo goes seven innings surrendering 2 runs. In a pitchers dual , the offense finally cracked late with homeruns by Ernesto Quintero and Jose Colon. Eric Taveras would provide a rbi sac fly that proved to be a crucial run. Next is game 4 , also in Philledelphia, which A's will start Henry Rivas ina crucial game. How will Henry Rivas handle game 4 in Philidephia? After returing from injury how are Henry Rivas stats? What is the feeling on Eric Taveras signing after a breakout season in Oakland?

sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: Pablo Almanzar gets the call in game 3, and continues to dazzle. Ernesto Quintero and Jose Colon handle the offense.

sportsFeeds.Notes: Albiet preseason, the Oaks still have yet to taste a win. Rookie AJ Dybantsa continues to show promise scoring 19 points, 7 rebounds, 2 assists. Wendell Carter plays his first game and played the first half and had 8 points , 8 rebounds. Austin Reaves, Adash Stanley, Dillon Brooks and Jermai Grant did not play
sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: The Oaks host game 2 of the preason vs the Warriors and are unable to give Oaklands new NBA franchise its first victory,

sportsFeeds.NamesUsed: Wilson Shepard (Coach), Austin Reaves (SG), Dillon Brooks (SF)
sportsFeeds.Notes: Still without a win to show for it but Austin Reaves and Dillon Brooks show great promise in the loss. Reaves scores 24 points and Dillon Brooks adds 21 points. Wendell Carter scores 12 points. Adash Stanles and AJ Dybantsa did not play. Media is now looking at Wilson Shepard for answers on why the team is struggling this preseason and when Adash Stanley injured wrist will allow him to play. Why havent we seen the entire team play together yet this preseason?
